title: Very important ClubCoin updates from BitClub Network Dec 24, 2015 - Ryan Conley BitLife Bitcoin
description: Come February 1st, BitClub Network will only give out 1 ClubCoin for every $5 you put into the network. Currently it is a 1 to 1 ratio ...

asr.full_text: Hey everyone, this is Ryan Conley, Residual Bitcoin Miner coming to you with a quick update on Clubcoin and the launch of Clubcoin and what is happening come February 1st. There's some really important updates that you guys have to know about this right now, because if you haven't noticed yet, first of all, Clubcoin has been at the top traded of all alt currencies in our first week the number one traded current altcoin and all of the alt currencies in our first week, The number one traded current altcoin in all of the altcoin exchange trading on bidtrex. That's something to pay attention to. We launched clubcoin at 5 cents, it's now trading at about 20 cents. That is a four times increase right there to 20 cents, which is beautiful. We really feel that clubcoin is gonna continue to go up just because of the infrastructure that we have in place but here's something that you must be aware of come February first things are going to be changing right now currently when you join bit club Network every single dollar that you put into bit club Network it results in one club coin on top of your mining contracts or you or whatever you put into so let me give you a hypothetical. when you come in on $99 membership one time fee with BitClub Network you're given 99 club coin. when you buy first mining pool share which is $500 a share, that is also a 500 club coin. our biggest package is at $35.99, which is 7 mining shares plus the one-time fee of $99. So that is 35.99 Clubcoin. But right now we're given an extra bonus of an additional 1500 Clubcoin on top of that. Come February because Clubcoin is skyrocketing in price so much, guys. Come February 1st, which is only a month away, basically right now, that you are only going to get one club coin for every $5 that you come into a big Club network that addition of 1,500 club going bonus is not gonna be an existence right there guys it is in your best interest as fast as possible to get to the founders level of that 3599 package right there the founders level because you will not get that bonus come February for first and also it's a 1 to 5 ratio so that again that 30 let's just take the $3,500 package for example that you are getting only 700 club coin plus 20 more you know in addition so 720 club coin for that 3599 package right there. There's a big difference right there. If you guys look at this right now. If you take action and you come in at even a $500 package right there, we get that up to a dollar a club coin is a complete wash on the mining share right there. OK, so this announcement was just brought to me by my enrolling sponsor Joe Able. It's really important that you guys take this seriously. If you've got a ninety nine dollar membership and you haven't upgraded into a mining pool yet, that you take the time immediately and start purchasing your Bitcoin because that process can take a little bit going through your local Bitcoin exchange. If you're dealing with whatever coin company you're using to purchase the bitcoin right there but it can take a few days. So, February 1st is gonna quickly approach guys. I would set your money aside and start purchasing some mining contracts to prepare for that right there and get your hands on as much Club Coin as possible. And you guys, thank you so much. I wish you a great holiday season and just let me know if I can help you with the upgrade process. Go ahead and subscribe to my YouTube channel below, and we'll get you guys involved in Club Coin, involved in the mining process with BitClub Network, before it is too late. Alright guys, take care. Bye.
